client_name.source_span: Cascade Ridge School District 12 is soliciting competitive sealed bids from qualified mechanical contractors.

project_title.value: Cascade Ridge Middle School RTU Replacement
project_title.normalized: cascade ridge middle school rtu replacement
project_title.source_span: The project is the Cascade Ridge Middle School RTU Replacement.

trade_scope.source_span: Trades required: HVAC, sheet metal, and controls.

location.source_span: Site: Cascade Ridge Middle School, Arvada, CO.

bid_due_date.source_span: Sealed bids are due no later than September 25, 2026 at 2:00 PM MT.

estimated_project_value.source_span: The District's engineer has established a construction budget of $850,000.

bond_insurance.value: 10% bid bond; 100% performance and payment; $2M/$4M GL
bond_insurance.source_span: Bid security shall be 10% of the bid amount. Performance and payment bonds are each 100% of the contract price. Contractor shall carry commercial general liability of $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 aggregate.

walkthrough_date.source_span: Mandatory pre-bid walk-through: September 11, 2026 at 9:00 AM local time. Attendance is mandatory.
